payload.name: Persist explicit counts for tracked group additions
payload.description: When a conversation introduces a new member of a countable group already tracked in memory, add or update an explicit total-count memory at decision time.
content: When a message or extraction candidate introduces a new member of a group already tracked as separate member memories, also create or update an aggregate count/state memory (ADD or UPDATE) at decision time; do not only enrich an existing event memory.
Record the current total and the as-of date from the message timestamp, keeping it concise, e.g., 'X has N [group members] as of [date]', using memory kind state.

solves: When a user reveals a new addition to a countable group already tracked via separate member memories, the agent often records only the new event and never persists an explicit total, so later count questions fail. This applies during construction decisions whenever a new member joins a previously tracked group: add or update an aggregate count/state memory. Do not apply when no prior members exist or the total is not clearly evidenced.
